blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — The Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6) has placed Western Visayas on full alert ahead of the 54th anniversary of the declaration of Martial Law on Sept. 21, deploying 5,155 personnel across the region. The alert took effect at 5 p.m. Sunday and will remain until 12:01 a.m. Tuesday as police prepare for gatherings and other activities marking the anniversary. The deployment includes 4,331 PNP personnel, 101 augmentation personnel from other government agencies and 723 force multipliers.
